Timesheet Maker

Build a weekly timesheet: enter start/end times per day, get daily hours, weekly total, and regular vs overtime split at 40 hours.

📖 How to use

  1. Enter start and end times for each day (24-hour format); leave a day blank for a day off.
  2. Press Calculate for daily hours and the weekly total.
  3. Read the regular/overtime split — hours beyond 40 count as overtime.
  4. Copy the summary for payroll or your records.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How is overtime determined?

The standard 40-hour week: the first 40 hours are regular, anything beyond is overtime. Daily hours are start-to-end minus any unpaid break you enter.

Can I enter an unpaid break?

Yes — the break column subtracts unpaid minutes (e.g. a 30-minute lunch) from each day's hours.

What about overnight shifts?

If the end time is earlier than the start time, the tool assumes the shift ran past midnight and adds 24 hours.
